source_summary: Foxconn Q2 2026 results state sustained AI server rack volume growth, rising AI-rack market share, Vera Rubin rack mass production in Q3, high-double-digit Q3 rack shipment growth and full-year AI rack shipments expected to more than double.
counter_evidence: AI products are high-value and complex; gross margin remains low at group level, so shipment growth does not guarantee proportional EPS sensitivity.

source_summary: GIGABYTE publicly markets rack-scale AI infrastructure/GIGAPOD and management reported 2026 AI business maintaining triple-digit growth with global server-capacity expansion; this supports a current economic edge to AI rack/system buildout.
counter_evidence: Product/platform exposure is clear, but customer concentration, accelerator allocation and mix/margin sensitivity still require monitoring.

source_summary: TEAMGROUP Q2 2026 results identify memory/storage modules as the business, report record H1 earnings, stable industrial/SI orders, ongoing memory supply gaps and a strategy to increase enterprise/industrial high-value product shipments.
counter_evidence: High memory prices can weaken consumer demand; inventory gains and channel pricing can reverse if the supply-demand gap closes faster than expected.
